text: Very good food. I got the chicken fried steak, scrambled eggs and hash browns with a side of bacon. I do think that the hash browns could have been cooked just a little bit more but that's my own personal preference. The place is super cute and the wait staff was very nice. Our waitress didn't come to our table often but, they were also very busy on a Sunday and it was right at the church crowd was coming in. I definitely will be back! I can't wait to try more food from here.

Found Maggie's place through a yelp search and was not disappointed! Maggie's is a small place but they give you a great spread! I had the scrambled eggs and chorizo which were amazing! Also their coffee cannot be beat in my opinion! Truly a gem of a find!

Tucked in the Nora shopping center (near Starbucks, in front of Target). Prices are $14-30ish for platters, which is an entree and two sides. Have had the pulled pork, brisket, ribs, bbq salmon, and shrimp & grits. All are good. The sides are good too. Recent pic here is hoping john (rice and black eyed peas) greens, mac and cheese, and cole slaw. No photo but super tasty is the adult milkshake ... vanilla ice cream, bourbon, salted caramel, whipped cream. #yum #ReviewsByRL

I had a group dinner there for my 40th birthday. I had some communication problems when working with their regional manager responsible for group dinners, but once I spoke directly to the restaurant everything worked out perfectly. They were extremely courteous and went out of their way to make sure our experience went well. I was also really impressed with the inexpensive banquet fee for the room use.

Highly recommend.

This place is quite the hit or miss. I've loved it and hated it on separate occasions. I had the most mind-blowing  chocolate chip banana bread French toast (it's a special) and then the soggiest eggs-Benedict ever! Definitely wouldn't cross off this place completely because when it's good, it's very good. Quite the greasy spoon though.

Im so glad that I found this place. The food was really good. We ordered the duck entree and my daughter got the chicken and pasta parmigiana. Everything was delicious. I didn't like my truffle fries(they put too much truffle oil on it) but overall very satisfied!

Just came here again and not nearly as good as the first time :( sangria was mostly soda and very watery, not good. My salmon avocado toast was so bad this time and last time i loved it!!!! Barely any avocado, so small, and my poached egg was cracked off of my toast. Not worth the $19 at all. Will post my last time size toast VS this. Such a different meal for ordering the same thing. Left hungry still and not cheap!!! Very disappointed this time around.

This place's service has really declined. I raved about this place when I first ate here, but my last 2 visits the service was below average. The wait for food was very long. I ordered the Crispy Calamari and it was chewy and tough. My sushi was good. Any waitress ( she looked 12) was very inattentive and seemed preoccupied. Had to be asked to refill our beverages a fews times. It's really a shame.

I have heard these wings are the best in the city. I would have to disagree. They were average. I tried the honey hot wings, the  sauce was very good but the wings were just ok. I was served all drums...no flats :( However, the blue cheese dressing is the BEST in the city. The items seemed to be priced very reasonably. I would visit again to try other menu items if I'm in the area.

Super cute atmosphere with serve yourself style eating. The teas are steeped perfectly and I highly recommend any of the herbal ones. I love studying and drawing at the huge oak tables and the relaxing ambience.

Top of the line sushi! The fish is great and the rice has been a great texture the last two times we've ordered takeout. My husband has ordered the Massaman curry twice and has loved it. Thankful to have this restaurant near by!
This place was great. Check it out if you stay near airport. Every server is super friendly. Don't miss the opportunity to get the home fries

Had the pleasure of eating outside in the garden. Definitely one of the best places in the city of Philadelphia. Great for brunch or dinner, but we had brunch and enjoyed the menu. I had the fried chicken and waffles as well as the sugar bacon, and gluten-free muffins that I highly recommend. Others in my party over the omelette, and the lox. We had such a great dining experience with good social distancing and plenty of room. The service was very good and we enjoyed the wine list as well. Specialty cocktails were also a good option

This Mc Donald's has to be one of the worse. Ghetto. And management is no better. I was just there and made an order at 10:30 for a breakfast sandwich they could have made. I even had to say hello  to get a answer. By the time she answered it was 10:31. She said they were outta bagels. Then she said it's 10:32. I asked for a manager. I heard them talking on intercom. That's what they like to do. Then they laugh at the customers thinking it's funny. All those minutes wasted the sandwich could have been made. It's raining and I'm trying to get in & out. The manager comes to ask how can she help me knowing they just had a conversation about it. I heard them. Then she said I yelled at her. Which I was not and told her that. Don't do that when I wasn't yelling. I'm in a drive thru. It's raining and I'm talking into an intercom that must be raggedy bc they seem to can't hear at times. Not the first time. Once I was in line for 20 min for breakfast and mind you one line was moving faster than the other and at 10:30 on the dot she says were no longer serving breakfast. I immediately asked for a manager and they made it. This is what they're supposed to do. I've seen staff sleep on top of tables! Once they told us at night they were only serving Drinks and fries!  had cleaning products at the window. I asked if corporate knew. They said no and tried to give us free stuff so we wouldn't tell! Don't nobody want any fries and pop. I don't drink pop! There's so...... much more. There was

Officially dropped off my keto diet as of this meal for vacation. It was worth it.

We arrived early to meet up with friends and even though we only drank two glasses of frosé (yes, slushy rosé!) and an appetizer, our waitress didn't mind us taking up a table for almost an hour. The appetizer we chose wa the zucchini fries and they were awesome. Crisp and tasty, still hot. Perfect for dipping into the spicy marinara sauce.

When our friends arrived, we got a garlic cheese bread and then our main courses. I was already hooked on the crawfish beignet. Not sweet and no sugar, this was all savory filled with seafood and topped with a tangy cream sauce. Amazing!

A fantastic meal, even sitting inside and upstairs. There is outside seating as well.

[Review 14143 overall, 1465 of 2020, number 15 in Louisiana.]

Pretty darn delicious! A week and a half before Mardi Gras, there's only a small line out the door in the morning before lunch and we thoroughly enjoyed some good creative Donuts. I had the Hibiscus one which was so flavorful and completely worth it. I would definitely come back next time I come to New Orleans!
This is the nest place in downtown hands down. The vibe is very chill and the people are amazing! I love this place to death!

I am beside myself. I found out about a week ago that one of my favorite places to chill outside, nibble on some Tapas, and sip some bubbly is going to be closed from now until April 2021. I literally cried a little when I heard this news, mostly because I don't know what happened (I'm guessing it has MUCH to do with the safety of the staff and of course income), so, I am deeply concerned that one of the coolest little spots in town might never resurface! I will say prayer upon prayer that they do! 

Take a look at the photo that I included in this review and you will see just how impeccable their presentation is. The food is always gorgeous, fresh and delicious and just the right size of course! I absolutely love their diverse choice of Tapas to include the Sardine with garlic Aioli, the Tortilla, the goat cheese with blueberry, and when they have the shrimp on the menu, I jump for joy! They change up the Tapa's menu once in a while and keep it fresh and they also offer up an incredible small, beet salad over arugula and topped off with a beautifully, silky, horseradish, parsley aioli of sorts. I love it so much that I tried to duplicate it at home, and came close, but no cigar!  They also have gorgeous sandwiches, a lentil salad, and many more items to tantalize the tongue! I really hope that they make it through this debacle of a pandemic, because if they don't, I will be one sad lady.

i just went here lastnight & everything was horribly presented . the crab cake pasta still had some 
shells in it and the alfredo sauce is very bland to add the burger they served  has no flavor hard & dry . they refused to let us order another dish after we sent the pasta back the chef is extremely terrible from costumer service down to the kitchen, srry but my experience here wasn't great at all !!!!!!

We had a great time! Shannon is the best 5 star!
Please expand your vegetarian options!
i stop by and ordered Korean BBQ, Most Korean food made this entire Phila area always disappointing? BBQ was just ok, little to sweet for Korean BBQ.

My family and I headed to Stanley's early on a Monday morning. It was highly recommended and we heard about the long waits. We were able to get a seat without a wait but if there was a wait, it would have been worth it!

I ordered the BREAUX BRIDGE BENEDICT and added the fried oysters. Absolutely delicious! The meal was rich and full of flavor! The ambiance was really cozy and seating by the window gave us a really nice view of Jackson Square. 

Highly recommended when you're in the New Orleans area.

We were disappointed with our dinner this evening. 1 st course I had the octopus appetizer and was shock to see the portion to price ratio.$15 appetizer better wow the hell out of me, instead it left me with WTF!! It was prepared well but for that it was NOT worth $15. We had a house salad for $12 that too was a very small portion for the price. Really? $12 for small salad with feta and tomatoes? They weren't heirlooms or anything like that. Probably Restaurant Depot or Produce Junction crap. The soup, split pea was an ordinary puree. My entree, moussaka was disappointing too. At first it came out and it was cold in the center, the side of green beans were tepid. The plate was messy on the rim, didn't even bother to wipe it clean. The eggplant were not peeled and it ruined the dish. Hardly had ground lamb or potatoes. Very sad. I've eaten there before and had a great moussaka but this was nothing close to what I had before. Service was good but I came here to eat. I didn't even start about the air conditioner.
Called 200 times and got hung up on the two times we got them on the phone. Not worth the effort of 20min on the phone.
Impressed with this special local gem! Seasonal menu infused with inspiration. Sincere enthusiastic service. Will recommend & return!

Good fresh food. Eat her a couple times a month. My only problem is that the gyro I typically order says it is almost $10 on the menu and yet it rings up after tax as $12 and change. How do they get from $9.89 to $12.36 or whatever. Oh well, it's good food.
delightful place.   great food.  will definitely come back     the service was also very good
Wonderful place for brunch! The staff was kind and helpful, menu was modern and exciting, and the food came out so fast! Coffe is also delicious and they have their own blend!
Cute place to gather in Channelside. Nice atmosphere and the grilled cheese/tomato soup appetizer was amazing!

I used to like going here or picking food up from here - food seemed standard for take out Mexican food, but I stopped going here after I got a large piece of hard plastic/acrylic material (almost the size of my thumb) cooked inside of my burrito.

Delivery during ncaa men's bball timeframe was super accurate.  Met delivery driver in hotel lobby and he was very nice.  Pizza was hot and cheesesticks were gooey good.  Detroit duo is enough for two basketball fans.  Detroit style pizza is yum!

ordered a dinner, take out. they gave me the wrong one. the gal that answer the phone, if you can get someone to, maybe able able to connect uou to a manager and shes a fun one. Six calls to get through to talk to the manager, of coarse itcwss my fault, i seemed to have 'RUSHED THEM'.. HOW?!

Brought the food back. got told they are giving mybmore expensive dinner at no additional charge... hmmmm, i am the one that drove another 40 minute round trip, did not get our salad on the second trip nor the bread. BUT ITS THE CUSTOMERS FAULT. 

Also like the way the money was innthe bartender / managers pocket. but my fault!

Had a really nice family brunch here! Very accommodating for a large party. Ordered the eggs Benedict (with ham), it was really good! Also ordered a side of a scrapple, cooked to perfection. Fair prices for quality. Cute place!

I stopped by on my way to work for a quick lunch and to pick up for my later meal at work.  I ordered two grouper  and the Cali fries with steak.  I ate the Cali fries for lunch and saved my tacos for later.  I wish I had the opposite as the tacos were awesome but they would have been much better hot off the grill. The tortillas tasted so fresh and good.  The Cali Fries were not what I expected.  They weren't bad but they didn't knock my socks off either. You get you choice of protein on the fries,  I chose steak and I wish the portion of protein was more.  Cut down on the portion of fries and increase the steak and it will be much better. Taste wise the fries were meh... I will definitely stop by and try their other menu items. The girl was super with customer service and was very friendly. She brings out the food to you even though I wouldn't expect with this type of establishment.

Okaaaaaay! I've heard a zillion people rave about this place, and I finally got in an order with the Legendary Mack!! 
Before I even got my order in, we were laughing on the phone. 
Very nice gentleman, and he answered all of my questions honestly 
Went with the shrimp and grits and NOT disappointed!! 
With the stay home order, and my mother being 65, going home for food for the soul simply isn't an option right now (but completely have a carry out order put in for next weekend from my Mommy ) 
I've never had s&g with lots of veggies so I was a bit thrown off. Ended up mixing everything together and it was MAGIC! 
Let's also not forget the shrimp. These were small whales!!! Seriously, I got about half way through and had to stop!

Thank you Mack, for driving my dinner a block and a half down Pershing so I wouldn't have to walk!
(In my defense I'm pretty deep into the Final Fantasy 7 remake at the moment and didn't want to "leave")

I invite and encourage everyone to try this place and or show them some love! I'm SO glad I did! 

Great job Mack, and thank you for the smiles and positivity that came with delivery!

We are so happy that we found this little gem! We are always looking for new places to support during these times that have outdoor seating, and we will definitely be back!  Our favorites were the Shrimp Fra Diavolo and the Chicken Parmesan (thick, juicy, and plentiful).   Best chicken Parm I have ever eaten, actually! And our server (Niles?) was excellent!
Ordered a breakfast panini to go and they did not put avocado on the sandwich, when the sandwich is supposed to come with avocado, but was charged full price anyways. Will not go back.
Hands down the best Mexican food I ever had in New Jersey.  We had the carnitas platter, shrimp tacos and carne asada w nopalitos and devour all of it. I highly recommend this place. Delicious!!!

Great food, great service, and great atmosphere! My boyfriend and I were running late to see a play and the staff was so accommodating that we ending up being early to the play! Such good food and a nice variety of options. The lobster ricotta ravioli is amazing!

Wow!
Now this restaurant knows how to make a killer breakfast! I had the best cheesy grits in my life here!
Their food is absolutely amazing!
I had the fleur de lit omelette and my boyfriend had the seafood eggs Benedict. We were living every bite!

And Frankie was absolutely amazing! 
The place was packed and he was on top of everything. 

I can't wait to come back and have a whole bowl of grits!

We re ready for Christmas dinner choices. 
Since The Ham will stay fine in the refer 10 days we got it early. 
And a side of frozen gravy. 
The smallest ham  today was 5.5 lbs.  Just  the two of us. 
It will be great. We've come here multiple 
Times for Ham dinners. 
Superior Place for Ham.

I have gone to this restaurant for many years and enjoyed it. Went on Sunday 10/13 and got the buffet as usual. The next day my husband and I became violently ill. We got food poisoning. Took us a week to recover. Needless to say, I am never going back.

True Food is such an amazing restaurant and really a unique place. Many folks in my family have specific eating requirements and I love that there is a somewhere I feel confident to bring them. Was a little thrown off by my initial interaction upon entering. Was not impressed with by the young woman with blue in her hair at the host stand. I asked if I could be seated in a particular area of the restaurant and got what felt like the verbal form of eye roll. Was shortly told I'd have to wait and she rushed away. I do understand urgency is important, but at a place that goes so above and beyond to give you a phenomenally accommodating  and happy experience inside it is strange to have a host making the guest feel a bit like an inconvenience. That being said I have dined here many times and it is always a pleasure once seated. Fun fresh food. Smiling servers, even behind the mask. I have always had at least one manager drop by the table to check in on the meal. Great place, would recommend to anyone. This place turns diet "restrictions" into a non issue. Being able to pick something right off the menu with only one modification! And a server informed enough to help at that. Wonderful.
I ate at Gigglewaters a few months ago and it's a quaint restaurant.   The food was wonderful and the service was excellent.    Definetly try this place out.
I felt like the food was kinda overpriced. My burrito was a little too salty and it was plain. There wasn't much sour cream added to it or cheese....

Im not sure how the entire order was made incorrectly but it was. Didnt notice that until we got it home and opened up the bag. I guess I needed to open it on the counter and check there?  It was also not very hot. Cheese curds are just not the same cold. Our family enjoys Culvers now and again but this location is not one we will be excited to return to. We will also not be referring friends or family to this location.

This place is absolutely delicious! There's a good food selection and everything we ordered tasted authentic just like our cooking at home. The presentation is phenomenal and prices are reasonable. A must try, especially if you like southeast Asian food.
Expensive Greek Salad with weird imitation feta cheese and SALTY dressing, Expensive DRY Pizza and toppings, SLOW service.  Definitely our first and last time.

Authentic and delicious every time! I placed a large order for work today. The owner, Jose delivered it himself in about 40 minutes. Excellent, personalized service, and the beef and chicken tacos were better than ever! Also best guacamole in Reno. Support this local cantina by ordering for take out or delivery. They are working so hard to earn our business!
Food was excellent.  Came out promptly.  The only issue was service.  It wasn't prompt and we had to ask for everything multiple times.  However,  all food and drinks were good.
One of the specials was potato soup--fantastic.  NY strip with the crab cognac sauce and the Parmesan fries were also amazing.  Great staff and the cocktails are wonderful.

Island Plate is amazing! I didn't realize how much I loved Hawaiian food until I visited a year or so ago. With that being said, I of course was sad to be home and unable to eat such wonderful dishes until I finally had a chance to eat at Island Plate! Everything I had was completely devoured! 

I had the fried noodles, my boyfriend had the loco moco and we both had a spam musubi! DELICIOUS! We were also able to compliment this awesome food with lilikoi tea which was definitely the cherry on top! 

I can't wait to go back and get my hands on some malasadas!

Last week, as the work day ended, I was feeling a little adventurous. I decided to wander about the neighbourhood to see if I could find a hidden gem of a restaurant. Sometimes just going out on foot is the best way to discover new food. 

Ten minutes and four blocks later, I was extremely disappointed to learn that most of the restaurants and cafes nearby catered to the business crowd. All the places I wanted to try were closed up for the day.

So, I headed down Jasper Ave. Now - let me tell you. Finding a good sushi place can be dangerous. You want to be careful with raw fish.

I stumbled upon Let's Grill and decided to give it a go.

Let's Grill is a small restaurant located on the corner of 107 street. I arrived at 4:50 pm and lucked out on window seating. There were a handful of other patrons who were quietly enjoying their meals.

The waitress greeted me with a smile and promptly took my order. Drinks were fast to arrive and so was the food. While the menu was small, there were numerous combos and options to choose from. I'm told that a small menu is a good sign. It typically means that the chef prepares the food on-site. Not like some chain restaurants who use frozen or pre-made foods.

All in all, my experience at Let's Grill was a positive one. The food was tasty. It definitely wasn't top of the line sushi - but if you have a craving and are on a budget - I would definitely recommend giving Let's Grill a shot.

Pro's: friendly and fast service, clean restaurant, nice

After drinking on burbon this was the closest spot offering something vegan. The cauliflower po boy was terrible but it was nothing to write home about. The sauce was good but the cauliflower was bland. I was a two drinks from Port of Call in so it did the job.
Accidentally found this place while working in the area. Excellent food and great service! I will back for more!

The steak tips were very good. The extra mushroom and onions were a little salty. Salad was fine, except I got ranch instead of the blue cheese.  I also did not get my brussels sprouts. This was a delivery order. I might eat in, but would probably not order delivery again.

Really good lattes! We came across this cute coffee shop while exploring downtown Zionsville. My husband and I both got vanilla lattes with oat milk. They were quite delicious and warmed us up. We will definitely be back!

This place made me feel like I was eating in India again! Born and raised in Mumbai city, I'm used to brilliant kebabs and biryani, which I fail to find in the USA. But after visiting these guys, I can safely say that I've finally found a place that serves something close to what we get back in India! Their biryani meal and the Tandoori chicken appetiser are both delicious. The lamb curry is spiced to perfection. Overall, the closest to an authentic Indian meal with the scrupulous flavours one would expect!

We take out at least 4-5 times weekly.  There quality is exceptional and they are super nice and accommodating.   So glad we discovered Als a couple years ago.   Also, we have  had there catering numerous times too.  They do an awesome job with catering too!!

Where do I begin?!?! If you can stand the heat, what are you waiting for?!?!  (Though there is plenty of shade, but all outdoor (under roof and canopies)).  Salt Shack is an oasis!  My photos don't do this restaurant justice! So sprawled out along the beautiful Tampa Bay! Meander along the walkways.  Seating available along the water under canopies as well as two very large pavilions with bars at each.  Beautifully landscaped throughout with decor of the islands/sea/beach.
I honestly did not expect the food to be as amazing as it is. Everything was absolutely delicious! The drinks were great. The service was perfect. All the staff are friendly.  Prices are very reasonable. 
Watched a pod of dolphins as we enjoyed our food and drinks. Our experience at Salt Shack was fantastic! Can't believe we had not been to this hidden treasure.

So we walked in without a reservation, immediately seated in the lounge with an awesome server, Alicia, and we were completely overwhelmed with the experience! The ride up the glass elevator was like being in a glass airplane during takeoff!!!  Not a bad seat in the place. Drinks are a bit pricy, but you have to have the mentality of going into an observatory where alcoholic beverages are served. Food was perfectly balanced and the seating was spectacular!  Definitely coming back here with a group for dinner! FYI. Restaurant/ dinner menu is served on the lower floor, just below the lounge (59-1/2)

This place is amazing!!!! Food and service was incredible beyond description. Anya, our server, was so great and attentive. We loved the sauce on our steak and eggs special so much, that she gave us the recipe!! The pork belly eggs benedict is something to be ordered- & the bottomless mimosas are a plus. Overall great experience!

We have been here several times since we enjoy the food. We called in to pick up an order today 9/25 around 6pm and they said to pick up in 30-40 minutes, so that's when we showed up. When we showed up, the man at the register said they didn't have our order, and that they would make it, but did not offer an apology at all. Eventually a woman behind him said sorry at the very end. We were fine with that as they said 10 minute wait. The restaurant was completely empty besides us, so we sat at some tables for the wait in front of the TV. The same man said that we had to move because it didn't look for people coming in to see us without food although the restaurant was completely empty. The way that he asked was matter of fact, rather than nice, on addition to the fact that they messed up the order and also he did not apologize for that. Just poor customer service. We asked for a refund and said we were going to take our business else where because of all the treatment we received, to which he continued to defend himself that it's policy and it doesn't look good, and that they don't change the rules for anyone. That plus them losing the order, and the guy we were interacting with not apologizing really soured the place for us. My partner used to work in the food industry, so we were both surprised by the interaction and we found this person to be very rude as he was defensive for quite a while, and the other staff just stood around as well. 

In the past, with other staff, they
Today 04/29/20 I had a wreck in the parking lot, I just want to say thanks to the manager for being so kind and helpful, thank you again.

I don't get it. 

The donuts are very popular. Like Madonna is I guess.  If you like donuts loaded with odd and sugary things this is your place. 

I like a traditional sugar, plain or glazed donut. Maybe even some filling but I don't need a snickers bar on it. 

The place is busy and the donuts are pricy. 

Is it a fad? Time will tell.
Everyone knows I love First Watch! The menu, the staff, the cleanliness, the great tasting fresh food! Never a disappointment and great portions are a plus! Catheline BH
Nice little local place that has very good coffee and a nice array of snacks and the like to enjoy with the coffee.. very nice counter help and coffee is always fresh

I've been coming to this place for a couple years. The wait are welcoming and excellent.

Their Gelato & Sorbet varies and are delicious. Pasta dishes hearty. Grilled veggie dish is amazingly good. 

I "cooked" at table the table once like my Dad taught me and added grilled veggies to their tasty Italian Margarita pizza. (Wait, you can do that??? Ah, use your judgement.)

Pretty cool environment just off Broadway so it was a little less crowded when I went in for lunch. I ordered the Thursday "Meatloaf Special" and it was phenomenal. Cut approximately 1" thick and covering most of the plate. Sat on mash potatoes and gravy and topped with crunchy onions.

Y'all. This place ROCKS. From the food to decor to overall vibe, SBC is setting the bar for trendy restaurants in Tucson. The ceiling is covered in license plates, so cool! For food, the Birria taco is unreal, the cauliflower and avocado taco is fabulous, and the carnitas is just as great. The tortillas are not cheap and hold all the goodness in, a big plus. My brother is a regular here and told me about the horchata latte. We each got one. Also, his burrito was HUUUUE and just as delicious as my tacos. So yummy! I do wish there was a drink menu posted somewhere, would definitely be a good move! Glad I let my brother take me here today!

We had Excellent service on hot Sunday afternoon. My cousin referred me to this spot, she's a frequent visitor. At the time we arrived the inside was pretty full & we were offered seats outside but luckily we were offered an indoor table in the corner by the bar. I ordered a French 75 & my friend got a Margarita. Our drinks were just what we expected. We ordered a few apps to share, charbroiled oysters, Blue crab cakes & Blue crab dip. The oysters were so juicy & tasted so good; it was our first time having them with cheese melted on top & we weren't disappointed. The crab dip was good but I thought it need a little more season/flavor, however still tasty. The crab cakes were really good, my favorite, Lump crab meat with a dip that complimented it very well! Our server was very attentive, making sure everything was to our liking & offering refills as we needed them. I'd definitely return!
Best margarita pizza in the northeast. We also tried several of the other dishes - chicken parm and nocci  were delicious. Definite our go to take out Italian restaurant.

The only place near me that has a Hawaiian burger. It was delicious. We also got a crispy chicken sandwich and my mother loved it. The vanilla and peanut butter shakes we got were pretty good, noting really special. The garlic Parmesan fries were also delicious. Would definitely recommend trying this place

First time here because someone recommended it and it was fairly close to home. Started off with a long wait even though we checked in through Yelp (they had "VIP" customers in line which went before us even though they clearly arrived after). They "ran out" of the dish we wanted (~11am, Saturday), and then put some pressure on us to make another choice quickly. Finally, they got our order wrong (wrong toppings on omelette, which was also way overcooked). The home fries were hard and the bread was not what they offered (said sourdough, got white toast). Only good thing was hostess was kind and their outdoor seating area is nicely shaded by cute looking umbrellas. Overall, disappointing experience. Won't be back to this location for sure.
Great place and great service! Employees are always friendly and very patient. The flavors are great and there are lots of vegan options.

Me thinks meh. Our favorite breakfast place was temporarily closed so we decided t give Nudy's a try. We sampled several flavors of pancakes including banana, pumpkin, and gingerbread. All of the pancakes were flat and not at all fluffy and had a processed, fake flavor to them. And the banana pancakes had a uniform banana flavor throughout them but no discernible bananas in them except for a few tiny rubbery pieces of banana that were obviously part of a mix. The pumpkin pancakes were similar but had several more pieces of something pumpkin like in them. And although I willingly admit that I have had some delicious pumpkin spice pancakes from a Sysco based mix in the past, I was really underwhelmed by what we ate here. If you are looking for fluffy, homemade buttermilk pancakes that are not from a mix definitely look elsewhere. We also had bacon that was ok but a bit undercooked and home fries which were average. The staff was ok but didn't seem overly friendly and just seemed to be going through the motions. At least most (but not all) were wearing their masks correctly. One nose and two stars for Nudy's.

I've never been impressed with District Tavern, but today was a big disappointment. Service was terrible, the food was terrible and no one ever asked about it. Sat at the bar and the male bartender took my order and didn't remember any of it and had to ask while entering it in the computer (Not too bad).  I waited for ever for my food while watching football. It was busy so I assumed the kitchen was backed up. None of the bartenders ever said anything why the food was taking for ever. Finally the food the came out and the quinoa was cold, broccoli was cold and the salmon was overcooked like a brick. I was starving so I ate some of salmon and pushed the plate away. Not one bartender asked how the food was or why I didn't eat hardly any of it. A female bartender took the plate away without saying anything. Instead of complaining or ordering anything else I decided to leave. I paid with $40 cash and the male bartender plugged in as $50 cash and then made horrible change (he shorted himself). Since it was difficult to get anyone's attention I tipped and left. 
There are better options in Channelside.

Went here for my 21st birthday and I was underwhelmed to say the least. Ordered food and needed a minute before I ordered drinks. The restaurant was dead and it took a while for our server to come back. Finally ordered drinks. Food came out before our drinks. Drinks took FOREVER. Finally got our drinks and mine was wrong but it was good so I can't complain. Our waiter was not attentive and never asked us if we wanted anything else and brought the bill instead. I wanted another drink but guess I have the bill and I'm tipping a waiter 20% for subpar service. Oh also was never asked for my ID!

Cute, small and intimate. There's a shop when you enter towards the back is the restaurant on the dock. They've got a really small bar, limited to beer and wine. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. I tried the buffalo shrimp it's an app portion but I had it as my entree ($12.95) it was AMAZING! Also had a side of the pasta salad which was really good. You have the option of adding a side for $3.50 to any app or entree. Their menu is mainly seafood of course and is based on their fresh catch for the day. I also tried the wahoo tacos and they were phenomenal. The reason I'm giving it 3 stars is because I had to ask the bartender for multiple things without being asked or even checked on. I will say they seemed a bit understaffed. Overall, it's worth the trip for the food.

Overheard many customers complaining when I sat down but I wanted to give it a try. Worse yaki soba ever. They used wrong noodles and sauce. My thai spring rolls were still frozen when they arrived. Servers are constantly on phones and not friendly. Truth be had, I wanted to try the bubble tea but did not understand and did feel like they could handle the questions. Best part of my visit was the thai iced tea otherwise I would have gave it one star.
The food is good here my new favorite is the  spaghetti the sauce is so delicious  that I ask the manager for the recipe and definitely try their works pizza and shrimp salad

I've never been here for anything except the Sunday brunch but can say that it's exceeded my expectations every single time. Unbelieveable waterfront views from outside or indoor seating (floor to ceiling wraparound windows through the whole dining room). The food is top notch as well. Every menu option I've tried has lived up to it's billing. The waitstaff is always attentive and friendly as well. If you're a Bloody Mary fan this is the best spot in Dunedin to get your fix.
This place has the worst service and the worst attitude of any customer service establishment I've ever come across. It's unfortunate that their employees have such a terrible attitude.

We didn't get a chance to go in person thanks to the quarantine/pandemic situation, but we did order it today via Doordash and we were not disappointed! The burgers were amazing, the sauce they put on it is really good, and I think it is a really nice value for the size of the food you get. When the stay in place order is lifted we fully plan on coming back in person! Amazing!

This was some of the worst Hibachi food I have ever had.

* The soup was mainly grease.
* The salad was half the size of a normal size.
* The fried rice was greasy, sticky, and gross.
* The chicken was not cooked all of the way through.

As high priced as this is and to get food this bad is just wrong. I am not sure how they stay in business and get get a descent reviews.

Online I had ordered a pizza before the super bowl from Pizza Dads.  My order was delayed and the bottom of the pizza was extremely burnt black. I immediately called and was offered a replacement with hesitation of the time.  I went back in person and was offered a replacement without waiting.  However, I am not that impressed with the pizza, its price, and would go out of my way for a good mom and pop style pizza.

This place is great, except I found a piece of cardboard in my açaí bowl. The french toast and waffles are amazing and I like how they give you a pitcher of water so you can refill it yourself, but I probably won't be back.

Bazbeaux is a staple in Indy and a great place for a yummy, filling lunch. All 3 locations (downtown, Broad Ripple and Carmel) have outdoor seating which is nice to enjoy the warmer weather. My favorite pies are the Roma, Colossus and Mediterranean. I love the thin crust and every inch is filling with toppings. Highly recommend!

Amazing and surprising! This place is the bomb!
Amazing staff. Foods even better! You will not be disappointed!

Ordered borscht, and vodka balls. Very friendly, very timely served, best place to get russian food besides your babushka's. Make you feel like family! If I could give it a 10 stars I would brings me back to the good ole times. !!

Fantastic dining. The food is excellent. My husband & I shared the Chateaubriand and it melted in our mouths. One of our friends had the scallops and said it was superb. Service from Holly & Johnny and all of the staff was wonderful. Johnny suggested the chocolate martini for dessert and we were glad we listened to him. Meal was topped off with a Creme Brûlée that was the very, very best I've ever had the pleasure to savor. It's a delightful supper club and yes I'll return. If you have the opportunity to, do it. Truly a fine dining experience.
My wife loved her meal but my pad Thai was not good. Dry and no flavor. If you want some great lad Thai try cafe equator in Severn ave. I'll try another item next time.

My husband and I went for our first date night since February (due to Covid) ... everything was clean and sanitized. Appetizer, we got the chili wings which were crispy and hot, we each got salads and then dinner came. Perfect timing between courses. Our server was friendly. We enjoyed dinner and the experience very much. Only thing I would recommend would be to improve on the ambiance/ atmosphere, it was a little dark.
His has always been one of my favorite taco spots to come to in Tampa. Without fail, i always go with the fried grouper tacos whenever i come here, and get them fully loaded. They never disappoint!

The concept of Condado is pretty neat! Filling out your own taco is both an entertaining and unique experience. What sounds good this time? A little of this? A little of that? All of the above? Good stuff all around. This alone makes Condado worth visiting. The atmosphere is on the louder end, but fits the trendy vibe, especially with it being right on Broad Ripple Ave. The service also was top notch and very accommodating. 

The online ordering is a little wonky which in normal times isn't a big deal, but it is during COVID. Special instructions have a character limit, and for some that can be cumbersome (as was my experience; had to order again in store). The descriptions of the different types of shells can be tricky to find as well. For people who do not like cheese (again, guilty), this combined can make it a difficult process to order online. 

Overall, I recommend visiting Condado in person. The full experience is there, and the tacos are pretty good. I was happy with my modified Plain Jane, Bad Habit, and any others I've custom-made. The same can be said for my wife as well as my sister.

We've been on vacation in beautiful Tampa Bay since last Sunday.  On Monday after shopping in Publix on St Pete Beach we came across this quaint Italian restaurant.

We gave their pizza and crispy salads a try and we were blown away.  Better than anything we have ever tried back home in Toronto.

Next evening we came for a proper dinner.  What an amazing treat;  coconut shrimp and Caprese salad were the delicious appetizers and Alfredo tagliatelle with veal, Osso Buco, Frutti di Mare and the Clams & Pancetta linguini were our dinner choices. Three of us shared a bottle of a very nice Barolo and my wife had their delicious homemade sangria.

Espressos, Tiramisu and Lemoncello Mascarpone cake were the perfect finish to a fantastic dinner experience at Buona Ristorante, on Wednesday night.

Diane was a very gracious hostess and our server Chris was very professional and personable.  They made us feel very relaxed and comfortable.

We will see you this weekend again to try a couple of the specials you mentioned.

John G.

It's Juan's! Consistently good food. Definitely not your authentic Mexican but they're also not trying to be. They're fusion of cuisine and they do fusion very well. Come out always tasty. My go-to is pork and slaw tacos. Always delicious. I usually get tarter sauce with them. Their tarter sauce is so good I always want to add it to everything. I'll always be back

It was a very pleasant night with the good folks at Ijji Noodle House. Prior to showing up there tonight, we made a reservation online through Yelp (super easy and quick) and I had the pleasure to chat with Kurtis who confirmed our reservation as well as suggested we asked our server for their favorite item on the menu (btw, it is a great way to Explore the menu when you're new to it) :)

We were greeted as we entered ans show to our booth right away. I gotta say, their customer service is outstanding. Jose did a great job making suggestions and explaining the menu as well as being super friendly and always checking on us to see if we needed anything and checking how the food was. From beginning to end the whole experience there was exceptional!

Kurtis himself makes sure to come check on us to see how everything was going and even surprised us with some delicious chicken wings (on the house). By the way, what  treat! Be sure to try their JAPANESE FRIED CHICKEN (KARRAGE).
We also made sure to try the takoyaki (octopus fried balls) and potstickers. Both delicious.

After getting to know this place through a Yelp Elite event, I had to have the VIETNAMESE SANDWICH Banh Mi Bolgogi Beef. The combinations of flavor is just delicious. Great treat to split as an appetizer.

For entrée we had the Black Garlic Ramen. It is well garnished and full of flavor. As an addition, they brought us some sauces, spicy on the side (requested) since they usually make this ramen spicy and we were ev

I'll start with the positives! Amazing views,
Location and atmosphere! If I were you I would just go to the bar and enjoy a few drinks and skip dinner! The staff is good but not great, we actually encountered a very rude cocktail waitress who yelled at us for trying to sit down at an empty
table and very rudely said she wanted to clean it off before we sat. (We had not sat, my husband just put his jacket on the chair to claim the table as it was very busy) to be honest the food was mediocre and not worth the price tag (maybe we
Ordered wrong) definitely do not get the chicken or the Mac and cheese. We enjoyed the wine and the complementary fries more then anything which says a lot. With so many amazing restaurants I would suggest to spend your money elsewhere on food.

First time here, and I wasn't disappointed. The pastrami Ruben is the best I've ever had, hands down! I should have taken a picture. They crisp the pastrami up so well, and it's incredible! Grant was a great server! Try it!
I come to this restaurant every spring and today was my lucky day because we got served by Josh. He was knowledgeable efficient and very friendly! The Ruben was amazing as usual! I'll be back soon.

I wantEd to like this place. Nice people and small, but intimate dining room. 

First, we were left standing at front door for almost 5 minutes while owner dealt with an upset customer. Everybody else ignored us so they could watch. It turned ugly with customers getting involved in argument. 

We ordered a meatball app  and arancini. Both about the size of a baseball. Both cold in center. The meatball a bit undercooked in parts. The reason you don't see large portions like this is because they are difficult to cook evenly. 

Wife had gnocchi. She enjoyed that. Friends had chicken parm and a pesto? Ziti. Both enjoyed. I had the chicken balsamico. Great presentation. More temperature issues. There were roasted red peppers in tHe dish that were ice cold. Ruined it. The side veggie was carrots/broccoli. They used the preformed baby carrots and they were uncooked. Mediocre food, but great presentation. 

All desserts contained dairy (out of fried donuts). No thought to patrons who don't eat dairy. 

It is inexpensive BYOB. $80 for 4 ppl, but need to work on food quality.
Lousy bakery  they need to stock more doughnuts theres always out of stock at 10am thats too early to run out people want them all day. Also the cupcakes i bought were stale last straw. Wont be back

I've never had Thai food before so I invited my family to eat with me. It was delicious and I will definitely be eating more Thai food in the future. We had a spring roll special that had salmon in it. I'm from the PNW so I like salmon in everything. It didn't disappoint.  We ordered curry chicken, pad Thai and basil chicken. The portions were good sized, saucing was perfect (not too little,not too much) and the dishes were colorful and just the right temperature. We had a Thai tea also. It was yummy.  I'm looking forward to returning and trying many new (to me) dishes in the future
I almost forgot about the service. Spectacular!  When the waiter found out I was a Thai "virgin " he was very helpful in making suggestions to help me enjoy my experience and made sure to use light heat. The small attention to details really means a lot
The staff is amazing!! Take out food is perfect. So lucky to have the restaurant in my neighborhood!!!!!
I will never, ever, eat here again. Place was dirty and disgusting. Two TVs were blasting South Park, which fit the atmosphere perfectly.

Thank goodness I came here right as it opened on Saturday for lunch. The inside has probably no more than 10 tables, so you should expect to wait to be seated. I really like the pricing options here and my dining partner and I chose the first choice. The meat came out promptly and servers were pretty attentive, which I appreciated. They even refill your banchan. I have to commend the beef bulgogi - it's well marinated and one of the best I've had. The only thing that I think it was missing was some lettuce for wraps. I love Korean BBQ and I'm sad that this is the only spot in town.

I'll admit this is a post amid the Covid issue so I wasn't able to sit in the restaurant and enjoy the food as I might normally have. That being said we chose to order some food for pick up the other day in order to be supportive of this local business. (We are just a bit too far for delivery.) The first five times I called I got a busy signal which might normally be a bit frustrating but honestly I was just happy they were busy during this awful time. Finally on my sixth attempt a nice young lady answered the phone. She took my order and told me it would be ready in about 20 minutes. The restaurant itself is about 15-20 minutes from my house so this was perfect! 

I jumped in the car and got their in 15 minutes. Decided to wait 5 in the car since I was early. At the 20 minute mark I went inside. Everyone was smiling and helpful. I have them my name and they grabbed my food. They were placing orders on the bar about 6-7 feet apart and sliding them down toward the cashier as it got closer to our turn to pay. They were selling Togo alcohol as well but I didn't partake. The atmosphere is so cute and I will definitely be back to sit and eat after all this has passed. 

The lady checking everyone out wiped the POS machine down between people and was efficient in getting us out. It was overall a really great experience even with all the restrictions on how they can serve the public. I'm thankful they are open, staying busy, and that they were so considerate of the social distancing

Meh. I get that it's a pandemic, but they were severely understaffed even with less customers. My main problem was that they kept taking online and to-go orders when they couldn't even keep up with the people onsite. I know they need to make money, but made for a mediocre experience. Props to our waiter who was running ragged and doing the best he could. 

Food-wise? Nothing to write home about. The pimento cheese is not pimento cheese; theater-like nacho cheese with some red peppers and mozzarella to stir in and served with maybe 7 crackers. I know they're known for the fired chicken, which I don't like in general, so I didn't try that. The chicken club was good, but again not out of this world.

The pizza was pretty good. My son enjoyed the chicken tenders, and my husband enjoyed the cheesesteak. The fries were very dry though. The low rating is mostly for how poorly covid rules were enforced. There were customers with no masks in the establishment, and there was no social distancing in place. My husband was extremely disappointed and uncomfortable. This was our first time ordering from here and unfortunately will be our last.

Need educated staff who can count money and who have people skills definitely in need of new employees very rude and tried to keep some of the money when they miscounted the money and caught her in the act she couldn't even look at us after

This was very good Italian restaurant.  Loved the linguine and crab the sauce was like homemade.
I am Italian and fussy about my sauce.  My husband had salmon salad he said it was cooked and seasoned well. I would definitely come back we ate o

First visit , we enjoyed our sat night out here. They have nice decor and ambiance. Seating inside and out and a pretty wide menu. We ordered way to much food and tried everything except dessert ! Next time ! They no longer serve the fried pickles which was disappointing everyone seems to rave about them. Recommend " the board " any salad add chicken/ meat. The fish and chips were yummy and the fried zucchini was really good. They serve fried chickpeas instead of bread or chips - not my thing but interesting and different .
They have taproom which is cool. It's separate from the restaurant. I'm have an roasters imperial coffee stout with a pretzel and mustard.

Great salads if I could go there everyday for lunch I would simply delirious.......
Great dressing 
Great salad 
Great food

Finally a breakfast/brunch place that's normal. It's like the unicorn of breakfast places: 
-creative seasonal menu
-reasonably priced
-not a greaseball
-not a "kale corner"...you know what I mean, the place that's all organic/vegan/free range blah blah blah

On the food note had an awesome eggs Benedict Florentine and the wife had the seasonal carnitas breakfast. Both were awesome. 

Hands down best thing is when you order coffee they leave the pot on the table...huge win!!
Great place breakfast lunch great spot downtown TV the salad are made for two of you share  if your on Terrie Verde   Have to stop in for that sandwich for the boat
Just finished a fabulous lunch from this place. Had a nova lox bagel was great . Not able to eat inside so took it home. Staff and service really nice. Got to do this more often.

This is my family's favorite takeout. Very consistent quality food. Sandwiches, pizza, salads, and several Italian entrees are all very good. They also carry many beers and have a wing special on Sunday.
Thomas Timothy

Great meal! They offer for to go & delivery as well! 
Fav italian food at the moment..
Being from Texas, it's hard to find great brisket in Tennessee. This place does BBQ right!
10 percent off take out! Loved the sashimi dinner! Fish was really fresh. The sushi was pretty good, but not the best.

Tonight my husband and I went here for the first time and were blown away by the stunning ambiance, excellent service and delicious food. I had the bronzino, roasted potatoes and squash - made so delicious and without the ingredients which I am allergic to (garlic, onion and dairy). My husband had margarita pizza, roasted chicken, potatoes and the chocolate torte cake. Everything was cooked fresh and to perfection and well seasoned.  Candles adorned the entire restaurant including the floors and in the bathroom, scented by my favorite Mrs Meyers. A fabulous experience and we will come back again and again. Best restaurant in philly.

I've had many delightful meals here. So, I'm sorry to give a negative review, but it's with the intent that the chef will go back to what made this restaurant great. First the paella. The  key to a good paella is the socarrat. The bottom layer of rice in the pan that should be chewy, crunchy and caramelized was not. Additionally, the patatas bravas which used to be chunks of fried potatoes drizzled with an amazing garlic alioli has changed to a collection of potato puffs that looked like they came out of prepared box( I'm sure they didn't). The prawns also lacked the same level of flavor we are used to. Maybe it was just an off night. I hope so because previously it was our go to restaurant and the one we wholeheartedly recommend to friends who visit Santa Barbara.

Wednesday lunch munchies and this place has been on my list to hit!  Read many reviews so I ordered the Tequenos and Pabellon....it is limited indoor during pandemic, outdoor, delivery, and carryout...

The Tequenos were a softly fried dough, similiar to maybe a food Kolache style dough, flavorful and filling...the cheese was not overly melted...i would have like it more...
The Arepa was delicious, different and a lil difficult to eat being stuffed so full of goodies....make sure to get the entirety of the bite in your mouth.  The sweetness of the plantain, savory meat and earthy blackbeans.  I also added some Tequeno sauce....the fork and finger method worked for me....

Overall give this place a try....i will return to try some Venezuelan goodies!

I live in Tampa and have seen this place on Facebook and finally had a chance to stop in. I love pickles and if you are looking for a pickle sandwich this is the spot. The sandwich is huge and very filling. I also had the pickle rolls which were awesome !! It is a great place to eat. Can't wait for another trip to South Jersey.
Their massaman curry is the best I've ever had. I'm so fortunate to live close by, as I would be devastated if I couldn't eat there often! I recommend Sawatdee to all of my family and friends.

Worst brunch experience ever! I would give this place 0 stars if I could! Our server was pressuring me to order a drink after I said I just wanted water multiple times, constantly disappears it took almost an hour to order and then when we finally ordered an hour after getting here he sprung a 2nd menu on us as we were starting to order. when I finally got the water there was a bug in it. I told him and asked for a new one and he said I'll get it when I come back, but he never came back and I had to go ask the bartender for water and she didn't even care about the bug. They upcharged members of our party because the restaurant ran out of champagne and started to use prosecco instead. They ran out of Bloody Mary mix so we wouldn't have been able to get a BOGO even if we wanted to and then wouldn't honor the specials printed directly on the menus that they passed out anyway. 
They say they can do so much for different diets online and I'm keto and trying to make substitutions was nearly impossible! To top it all off the food was very bland and we had to heavily season it ourselves. It took nearly 2 hours to get food we were all starving so we ate it all anyway. When we asked about discrepancies on our bill, the manger was even rude telling us she couldn't do anything about it. She pulled her mask down while speaking to our table and just made excuses as to why things were the way they were regarding changes and stuff even though they're written allll over the menu different spe
Outstanding Chinese food. Portions are large and delicious. There Specials are the best. Don't forget their egg roles and egg drop soup.

Absolutely delicious! We got the spicy seafood hot pot, the sizzling plate with rice, fried spam musubi, takoyaki, fruit tea, and milk tea. The broth for the hot pot was so flavorful and soothing. They also fill it to the brim with food so you're really getting your money's worth. The sizzling plate was soooo good and went well with the hot pot. The drinks we got were pretty good as well. The staff was super attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. The ONLY bad thing I can say about this place is the spam in the fried spam musubi was pretty raw. Other than that awesome experience!

Last night 8:30 reservation 10 minutes turned into thirty minutes plus...but thought it'll be worth the wait. Requested to be seated in a specific area and was told thats where we're seating you anyway but ended up in a corner....Things where cold my croutons and dipping sauce for the crab rangoon. I've bragged and recommended this place because of those two simple things that served warm are amazing. Its even listed warm croutons....again when executed are amazing!!! My husbands entree gummy lobster ravioli. Why disrespect lobster in this fashion? My Sons fried lobster didn't disappoint nor did mine but the mash potatoes will give you have you screaming for water. Crab rangoon and onion rings delicious overall. Our server Malissa tried she started out strong epic fail. Promised free dessert from manager and a 25 gift card towards dinner was given only for her to say the gift card was to pay for dessert...no it was towards entree as previously said by management. Think Malissa, why would the comped desserts be in your computer if the gift card was to cover them??? Then for you to come back to divulge your rationale was distasteful...the tip given was primarily for the sake of giving a tip. However her shenanigans cost her a tip that would have been far more $$$. At one point I felt sorry for her being cursed by the inebriated table beside us. My original tip plan was going to cover what she didn't get from them. So to say the least this "retry" was almost ok but almost doesn'

Really loved this place. Definitely coming again soon. The honey chicken and the beef and broccoli are both delicious. Prices are also great and the lunch specials are every day, including weekends. The family who owns it is also very sweet and were genuinely happy when we told them how much we loved their food.

Such good tacos for a pretty decent price. Go on Tuesdays to get the $1 taco deal! I recommend the carnitas taco. I also like how they have the option to add extra toppings to your taco, but extras do come with a fee.

Branden who works the night shift on the weekend is an absolute legend! He is super kind and charismatic. I love seeing him there. 

As for the food, it is pretty good! They cook the meats right in front of you, and give you generous portions of everything. Considering this is right next to where I live, it is an extremely convenient place to go and grab a quick bite. 

I will warn you, the spicy sauce is INCREDIBLY spicy. I normally can handle spicy foods really well and always max out the spicy. The first time I got this, I got 5 lines of spicy sauce and it absolutely destroyed me. 1 or 2 is good enough, but that's considering I can really handle the heat, so if it's your first time trying the spice, I recommend one line or a half line. 

The rest of the staff is also really friendly. Recommend this place!
Love this little family owned gem in Music Valley. One of the best Thai spots in Nashville IMO.
Burger was delish, but tempura green beans were too salty. Next time I'll ask they hold the salt. Regardless, we'll come back when we're in Sparks.

The food is fabulous! I love how you provide the coronavirus safe environment. The outdoor seating is very nice and after the pandemic I recommend you keep it. The food is still amazing of course. Especially the bread!

The tacos tasted great, but the actual system was far harder to navigate than I expected when I was hungry. Lots of menu options is a plus. Not great for just picking up tacos- their combo meals were the better option.

One of the things I love about Dunedin (aside from the craft beer) is that you can park and jump around to so many amazing places. One place to avoid, Beso Del Sol, otherwise known as Marker 8. Not only will they tow your car if you don't stay there and drink their overpriced drinks all day (unlike all the other Dunedin spots) the service is terrible! 

They do not offer the same hospitality and patronage as the other Dunedin restaurants and breweries, and don't offer any of the local brews. Service is slow, food choices are low quality and extremely limited, and drinks are weak and over priced. 

Want to swim and drink? Go down the road to Ozona Blue which literally blows this place out of the water! 

For a beautiful Dunedin sunset, superb fish tacos and delicious craft beer go down the street to Old Bay. They offer free parking and you can jump around to all the amazing places downtown Dunedin has to offer. 

In short, skip this place when visiting Dunedin. It does not fit the hospitality or ambiance of this beloved, historic downtown area.

What a lovely place for a more upscale dinner in New Orleans. We made reservations for an early dinner here and we're glad we did! Ordered hurricanes at the bar which were a little too sweet but had really delicious crunchy ice. The courtyard is absolutely breathtaking with lights hung in the trees and a well in the middle. Service was impeccable and the food was to die for! I ordered the filet which was cooked perfectly medium rare. We also had bananas foster made tableside which was a delicious show! 

Just to reiterate how amazing the service was here - my friend ordered the pork chop and it came out a little bit dry. As soon as she mentioned this to our waiter he immediately offered her another entree of her choice for no extra charge. Cannot day enough good things about this place!
My first time trying both dishes because i saw them in a food competition show and i was not disappointed!! So good. literally nothing to complain about.

This was the WORST sushi I have ever experienced. Not fresh fish at all and old frying oil. The owner is a complete a@!hole and charged us for all the garbage food we sent back! Don't go here!!
If I could give it a 0 I absolutely would!  The worst!

Terrible customer service. We went to try this place for the first time yesterday and was extremely disappointed. I placed an order online & started to drive to the restaurant 15min after my order was placed ( it said it would be ready in 20 min) I get a phone call & the woman said they were sold out of an item. I then asked if they had chicken, he response was quick, rude and annoyed. I asked what they did have on hand and she huffed and just started to get even more frustrated. I ended up canceling our entire $100 order. This was our first experience and we will not be trying again.

We were there last night with family from California. We're we're wowed. We all agreed to the Chef's Menu and once the dished started coming that just didn't stop.  I think we got to try the entire menu! Each dish was delicious and so carefully prepared. The serving staff was very knowledgeable and attentive. Our dining experience was a highlight of our time in Nashville. And a shout out to the local farmers who grew this delicious food. @villaacres @barefootfarmer
Went for Moe Monday got 2 burritos and a bowl ALWAYS VERY GOID !!!    Service was good too.

Good food, good prices, fast service, until they wanted you to leave- an 815 reservation that doesn't order dessert at 1010 with 4 of the wait staff peering at our paid check - just wanted to run out- uncomfortable

This place is perfect for catching up with friends over wine and cheese. I love that you can design your own board!!!! The cheese selection is amazing and the prosciutto is some of the BEST I have EVER had!!! Love love love this place! It's always a sure thing!

This place has the best socially distanced table set up I've found. We felt super safe. Everyone is 10 feet away and they have a really great masking policy when people leave their table. I felt fine bringing my 70 year old parents here for drinks and dinner. Plus, THE FOOD IS AMAZING. The buffalo cauliflower roles were so good, I went back a few days later for more. The breakfast wrap and fried chicken is also delicious. I couldn't have asked for better service. This place is the best kept secret of the pandemic.

Been here multiple times now... if you're gluten free this is a must try. They also have a few dairy free options as well. 

The inside is cute and cozy! With COVID there is distancing, as well as seats outside. 

The food is amazing!!! I've had their sandwiches, desserts, bread, cupcakes and it's all been amazing! If they have the pumpkin bacon waffles, get them!!! Love their BBQ sandwich as well as many cupcakes and treats. 

Their service, most of the time is great! However, there's been a few times I've had to get someone or ask for someone. This is the only reason I'm giving them 4 stars. 

However, I'll gladly be back!!!
Cool place, I chose the Costa Rica black. While its good, certainly not the best roast of all reno. Appears they are more solid on their lattes
